sermon.title: Who is your Father - September 15, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Part of the “What is a Christian?” series: God the Father cannot lie, and His love is shown at the cross. Jesus said some were of their father the devil—whom are you imitating? Satan wants to sift us, but Christ prays for us, and like the prodigal we can return to the Father.
